Growth, volatility, and deficit history within each organization

Source: R/outcomes.R
trend_measures.Rd

Year-over-year growth, revenue volatility, and the count of deficit years over a trailing window. Windows are defined on calendar years and never use future years. Growth needs a return in the prior calendar year, so filing gaps give NA rather than a multi-year change.

Usage

trend_measures(
  x,
  vars = c("REVENUE", "EXPENSES", "CONTRIBUTIONS", "PROGRAM_REVENUE", "NET_ASSETS"),
  k = 3L,
  min_obs = k,
  id = "EIN2",
  time = "TAX_YEAR"
)

Arguments

x

An organization-year table with merger_measures() columns.

vars

Columns to compute growth for; each adds <var>_GROWTH.

k

Trailing window length in years for volatility and deficits.

min_obs

Minimum returns in the window for REVENUE_CV and DEFICIT_YEARS (otherwise NA).

id, time

Organization and year columns.

Value

x with <var>_GROWTH columns, REVENUE_CV (coefficient of variation of revenue over the window), DEFICIT_YEARS (returns in the window with expenses above revenue), and N_TRAIL_YEARS (returns in the window).

Details

Growth is the symmetric (Davis-Haltiwanger-Schuh) rate (v[t] - v[t-1]) / ((|v[t]| + |v[t-1]|) / 2), bounded to -2..2. Unlike a log change it is defined for zero and negative values (net assets), and it is close to the percentage change for small changes.

References

Mayer, W. J. (2023). Simmer or boil: Revenue volatility and nonprofit dissolution. Nonprofit and Voluntary Sector Quarterly.

Examples

x <-
  data.frame(
    EIN2     = "A",
    TAX_YEAR = 2018:2021,
    REVENUE  = c( 100, 120, 90, 90 ),
    SURPLUS  = c(   5,  -2, -8,  1 )
  )

trend_measures( x, vars = "REVENUE" )
#>      EIN2 TAX_YEAR REVENUE SURPLUS REVENUE_GROWTH REVENUE_CV DEFICIT_YEARS
#>    <char>    <int>   <num>   <num>          <num>      <num>         <int>
#> 1:      A     2018     100       5             NA         NA            NA
#> 2:      A     2019     120      -2      0.1818182         NA            NA
#> 3:      A     2020      90      -8     -0.2857143  0.1478250             2
#> 4:      A     2021      90       1      0.0000000  0.1732051             2
#>    N_TRAIL_YEARS
#>            <int>
#> 1:             1
#> 2:             2
#> 3:             3
#> 4:             3
